remarks: Welcome to 44 Maple Street, a beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated home in one of Darien's most convenient locations. Just half a mile from Noroton Heights' shops, dining, and train, this property makes everyday errands simple, and commuting a breeze. Originally built by Giannattasio builders in 2017 and enhanced with quality updates by Ruddy Builders, the home has been meticulously cared for. The layout features 5 spacious bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, including finished spaces on both the third and lower levels. The heart of the home includes a dream kitchen overlooking a family room with vaulted ceilings. The separate dining room, library and mudroom complete this perfect first floor. 4 of the 5 bedrooms are on the second floor, 2 of which have their own bathroom, and the other two share a generously sized bathroom. The primary suite is a true retreat, with a beautiful en suite bathroom, a large walk-in closet, and plenty of additional closet space. The third floor includes a media/rec room, while the lower level offers additional space. The property also boasts a generous backyard, offering ample space for entertaining, play, or relaxing outdoors. Move-in ready and ideally located, this home combines a functional floorplan, beautiful construction, thoughtful updates, and everyday convenience in the heart of Darien.
